address: 91-95 Upland Road, Remuera, Auckland, 1050, New Zealand
bio: Bustling with well-heeled business people and families, this modern bistro has a casual, on-trend feel. The owner-chef, of Māori-Italian descent, opened Morell with his wife in 2017 to celebrate his blended culinary heritage. The menu follows the season but always showcases locally sourced ingredients crafted in traditional Māori and Italian ways. Try his Bologna meatballs with toasted focaccia or tagliatelle to soak up the thick, rich sauce.
